title: When VLMs 'Fix' Students: Identifying and Penalizing Over-Correction in the Evaluation of Multi-line Handwritten Math OCR
abstract: arXiv:2604.22774v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate transcription of handwritten mathematics is crucial for educational AI systems, yet current benchmarks fail to evaluate this capability properly. Most prior studies focus on single-line expressions and rely on lexical metrics such as BLEU, which fail to assess the semantic reasoning across multi-line student solutions. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of multi-line handwritten math Optical Character Recognition (OCR), revealing a critical failure mode of Vision-Language Models (VLMs): over-correction. Instead of faithfully transcribing a student's work, these models often "fix" errors, thereby hiding the very mistakes an educational assessment aims to detect. To address this, we propose PINK (Penalized INK-based score), a semantic evaluation metric that leverages a Large Language Model (LLM) for rubric-based grading and explicitly penalizes over-correction. translated_abstract: 手写数学的准确转录对教育AI系统至关重要，然而当前的基准测试未能正确评估这一能力。以往的大多数研究都集中在单行表达式上，并依赖于BLEU等词汇层面的指标，这些指标无法评估多行学生解答中的语义推理。在本文中，我们首次对多行手写数学光学字符识别（OCR）进行了系统性研究，揭示了视觉语言模型（VLM）的一个关键失效模式：过度纠错。这些模型没有忠实地转录学生的作业，而是常常“修复”错误，从而掩盖了教育评估本应检测出的错误。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PINK（基于INK的惩罚评分），这是一种语义评估指标，它利用大语言模型（LLM）进行基于评分标准的评分，并明确惩罚过度纠错。我们对15个最先进的……
tldr: 该论文首次系统性研究多行手写数学OCR，揭示了视觉语言模型“过度纠错”从而掩盖学生错误的关键失效模式，并提出了PINK语义评估指标来显式惩罚这种过度纠错行为。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of multi-line handwritten math OCR, revealing a critical VLM failure mode of "over-correction" that hides students' mistakes, and proposes PINK, a semantic evaluation metric that explicitly penalizes over-correction.
